Also, make sure to use uBlock Origin and not "uBlock" from uBlock.org

Both were started by the same person - Raymond Hill.

uBlock later pulled some suspicious shit and the author stopped contributing to the project, instead he created uBlock Origin and continues to maintain that.

The original developer decided to stop working on uBlock and handed it over to another developer whom he thought was going to take good care of it. The new developer had other plans. He seemed more interested in collecting donations than improving the codebase. He barely did any work on it. So the original developer came back to the project and forked his own code under the new name of uBlock Origin. That's the preferred project.

uBlock Origin is a developer from the original uBlock dev team. uBlock (prefork) was sold on some features that the original developer didn't support and didn't want to fight about, so he forked and started uBO. That's the watered down answer.

I use uBlock Origin and Ghostery. Ghostery blocks more then just ads, it also blocks third party stuff that could be tracking information like facebook plugins, and you can selectively allow things if needed.
